Practice Manager at Essex Way Surgery continues to disregard serious complaints regarding substandard patient care.

I submitted a formal complaint in April 2025, and despite several months, it remains unanswered. It is now September 2025, and not only has the Practice Manager failed to respond, but they also routinely ignore emails for FOI Requests and SAR Requests
What’s particularly troubling is that although the Practice Manager has access to a designated NHS complaints email address, patients are instead directed to a generic surgery inbox—accessible to all staff members. This undermines confidentiality and raises serious questions about the professionalism and integrity of the complaints process at Essex Way Surgery.

Essex way surgery used to have a Facebook account but because so many patients were complaining about patient care it was removed. The official NHS website review site for Essex Way Surgery had all the reviews deleted and the ability to put reviews taken away.
